explication: Titanium Browser is an Android Chromium-based browser. The principal workflow is: an Android user navigates through the browser UI, the navigation/session layer invokes Chromium, Chromium retrieves web content, and rendered results return to the UI. Extension management adds unpacked or marketplace extensions through Android’s file picker, while privacy settings configure browser behavior such as WebRTC policy. The sampled repository contains mainly extension packaging code; runtime implementation is represented by the documented Vanadium submodule path, so some internal call relationships remain necessarily high-level.
